notes.problem: Dead lower third, spirals as noise.
notes.fix: Lower the camera, extend plate and vise into the bottom third, seat chips with contact shadows.

notes.problem: Front ghost shows the back bar through it so 27 reads near 70; top ghost reads full length; bottom 40 percent empty.
notes.fix: Frost both ghosts translucent white, pull the bars apart in depth so neither occludes, drop the camera low and close.

notes.problem: Bars unlabelled, stray springs, background scribbles, dead lower third.
notes.fix: Accent pills 'volume' and 'files' on the bars, delete springs and line noise, lower the camera so the bars fill to the headline.

notes.problem: Soft bench, subject under a third, engine a blur, rules cross the dek band.
notes.fix: Camera to bench height and in, a recognisable fir-tree-root blade sharp in the lower half, dek clear of rules.

notes.problem: Nothing inspects; blade a flat slab; type on a flat wall plate.
notes.fix: Twisted airfoil in a foam cutout with a gloved hand holding the borescope at the gold band, camera in, lit door panels behind the type.

notes.problem: Tray, probe and part do not read as an inspection at feed size.
notes.fix: Push onto the tray and add a gloved hand touching the part, matte gold band.

notes.problem: Blisk under a flat pale band, not a disc inside an engine.
notes.fix: Model the case wall and far disc so blades recede into indigo, drop the flat band.

notes.problem: Top 42 percent a flat navy plate, hub a flat plane with drawn lines.
notes.fix: Raise and rotate the camera so leading edges climb behind the body copy, crop the hub out.

notes.problem: Gold tick strip unexplained, flat key across blades.
notes.fix: Make the strip a partly filled life gauge, rake the key from the right.

notes.problem: Unplanned riveted boom reads as a helicopter tail boom.
notes.fix: Replace the boom with an indigo bench mat so the rule and tab are the only subject.

notes.problem: Diagonal rail reads abstract at thumb size, pill floats.
notes.fix: Rotate the rail toward horizontal, seat the tab at a visible 480 tick with the pill on it.

notes.problem: Intake faces camera as on the cover; stray white tag on the stand.
notes.fix: Rotate the engine so exhaust and turbine flange face camera; remove the white tag.

notes.problem: Stand untextured square tube, cases matte blocks on a plain sweep.
notes.fix: Camera to knee height and closer, chamfered tube stand with gussets, moulded ribbed cases with recessed latches.
